LANDSCAPING  The  City  Council  approved  items  A, B, C, D & E during  Consent
  Calendar:

  a.  Agreement  (Contract  No.  2025-13-CC)  with  Golden  Coast
  Construction  Inc.,  for the construction  of the 9923  San Luis  Avenue
  Parking  Lot  Improvements,  City  Project  No.  63-SP,  in an amount  not-
  to-exceed  $105,168;

  b.  Appropriated  $176,000 from  the General  Fund  Reserve  to fully  fund
  the 9923  San Luis  Avenue  Parking  Lot  Improvements,  City  Project
  No.  63-SP;

  c.  Declared  9923  San Luis  Avenue  Parking  Lot  Improvements,  City
  Project  No.  63-SP  to be Categorically  Exempt  under  Title  14 of the
  California  Code  of Regulations,  Section  15301  Class  l of the
  California  Environmental  Quality  Act  ("CEQA");

  d.  Authorized  the City  Manager  to approve  pre-payments  of construction
  progress  payments  for the construction  contract  to meet  compliance
  with  state legislation  that requires  payments  within  30 days;  and

  e.  Authorized  the Mayor  to execute  the Agreement  in a form  acceptable
  to the City  Attorney.

WATER  The  City  Council  unanimously  approved  items  A & B during  Consent
  Calendar:

  a.  ArticlesofAgreement(ContractNo.2025-15-CC)fortheCalifornia
  Water/Wastewater  Agency  Response  Network  (CalWARN)  2007
  Omnibus  Mutual  Assistance  Agreement  to participate  in mutual  aid
  support  during  emergency  situations  affecting  the City's  water  system;
  and

  b.  Authorized  the Mayor  to execute  the Agreement  in a form  acceptable
  to the City  Attorney.

PERMITS  The City  Council  unanimously  continued  the Public  Hearing  to the
  regularly  scheduled  City  Council  meeting  of February  25, 2025, by motion
  of Vice Mayor  Barron  and seconded  by Mayor  Davila:

  a.  A Zoning  Code Amendment  to adopt an Ordinance  amending  Chapter
  11.21  (Land  Use Types)  of Title  11 (Zoning)  of the South  Gate
  Municipal  Code, to allow  restaurant  uses and (ancillary)  alcohol  sales
  within  the Open Space (OS) zoning  district;

  b.  ApprovingaConditionalUsePermit(CUP24-15)toallowthesalesof
  alcohol  (ABC  License  Type 41 - beer and wine)  for on-site
  consumption  in conjunction  with  an existing  restaurant/caf6  located
  within  a soccer facility  at 9599 Pinehurst  Avenue  (the "SoFive  Soccer
  Complex");  and

  c.  Continue  the Public  Hearing  to the regularly  scheduled  City  Council
  meeting  of February  25, 2025.

  ROLL  CALL:  Council  MemberAvalos,  yes; Council  Member  Hurtado,
  yes; Council  Member  Rios, yes; Vice Mayor  Barron,  yes; Mayor  Davila,
  yes.

  Raul F. Salinas,  City Attorney  - The applicant  is not present  today  and is
  requesting  to continue  the hearing  to February  25, 2025. The public  can
  comment  on this item,  comments  will  be on record,  but the council  would
  not be able to comment.

  Maria  Davila,  Mayor  - We will  be listening  to all audience  comments,  but
  as council  we will  not be taking  any actions  tonight.  This item will  be
  moved  to February  25Ih,

  public  input  on community  needs and potential  goals for consideration  as
  part of the development  of the 2025-2029  Five-Year  Consolidated  Plan by
  motion  of Council  Member  Avalos  and seconded  by Council  Member
  Hurtado.

  ROLL  CALL:  Council  Member  Avalos,  yes; Council  Member  Hurtado,
  yes; Council  Member  Rios,  yes; Vice Mayor  Barron,  yes; Mayor  Davila,
  yes.

  Carol Averell,  Community  Development  - Bringing  this item to receive
  public  input  on community  needs and goals for the consolidated  plan.

  Aria LeNoue,  Housing  Consultant  - Speaks and provides  the Five-year
  Consolidated  Plan PowerPoint  Presentation.

  Maria  Del Pilar Avalos,  Council  Member  - Can we put the survey  on our
  website  and also on the app?

  Mayor  Davila  asked if anyone  in the audience  wished  to speak on this
  item.

  Mario  Dominguez,  Resident  - Would  like for these funds  to go towards
  the use of our parks.  I want that money  for a splash pad.

  Edgar  Pelayo,  Resident  - There  are streets out there that need fixing.  Next
  to where  the mayor  lives.  The city council  should  go and take a drive  out
  to Mallison.  It needs attention.  Parks can use this money.
